blurb: Gillette Ridge Golf Club is a public golf course designed by Arnold Palmer, featuring tree-lined fairways, natural obstacles, streams, lakes, and elevation changes. The course honors local historical figure Francis Gillette and offers a dynamic layout that tests all playing skills. It is recognized as one of the best public golf courses in Connecticut and New England.
